title: Unit Event — Step by Step! — Episode7 A Heart-Thumping Surprise

meta.Event Outline: Minori has told her groupmates in MORE MORE JUMP! that she wants to switch to the credit-based course. This hasn't been an easy decision to make, but she's been supported by some special people.

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Saki, what's going on?!
Where are we...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, we're here♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hi, Minori. I hope work went well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on here...?!
Why are you all...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
It's time to start our “Good Luck Minori and Haruka” party♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, Haruka and me...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I heard from Saki that you'll both be switching over to the credit-based course soon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Saki told you...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Shiho and Kohane were the ones who told me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I realized that we wouldn't be able to hang out and have fun like this as much after you two go credit-based...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I was hoping that we could have one last party to remember before you make the switch!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We weren't sure about throwing it today since it's getting late...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But this was sort of the only day that we could get to work because we all have practice and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right! So, we decided to do it today since it'd also be a nice surprise!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, it is a bit of a miracle that we were all free today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Unfortunately, because it's already kinda late, there isn't a whole lot we can do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But get ready for an unforgettably fun party, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Saki... All of you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you!
It's so nice of you to do this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting to be thrown a surprise party.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I couldn't believe it either when I got a message about this earlier.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I do agree that we should take this opportunity to have as much fun as we can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okie dokie!
Let's get this party started!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Up first, we have...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: These new cakes on the menu are supposed to be really good!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, they only serve them at night...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Then it's good we chose to come today!
But there's so many different types. I don't know which to choose...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, let's all get different ones and share them with each other! That way, we'll all get to try a bunch!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
In that case, I think I'll get this one with a rabbit on top.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A rabbit, you say?
It suits you rather well, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: W-We're all getting something different, right? It's not about what suits who...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, I'll get the one with a bear on top. You can eat the bear, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Look, you're getting the wrong idea!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I can't get any hits...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
To be fair, you have already...
On someone else's lane...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You did the same thing last time, Minori.
se_event_step_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, that sound...! Someone just threw a perfect game! But who...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um, I somehow managed to hit them all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...!
Did you use your idol powers or something...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, but...!
I'm an idol too!!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-You can do it, Minori!
I'm sure your next one will hit!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Maybe a tad to the right... Just a tad.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: L-Like this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, Ichi, that's too far!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Darn...
I was so close.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Did you all win anything?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, nothing on our end... Wait, huh?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-Where did you get all those plushies?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, so... Aoyagi's really good at these games and taught me how to win stuff from them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! Toya's really skilled when it comes to claw machines! He's won stuff for me before!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm still nowhere near as good as he is, but I tried putting what he said into practice...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's incredible...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please teach me, Professor Claw!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You couldn't come up with a better name for her?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
Hanging out together like this is so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And I couldn't be more grateful that they're taking the time to do this. I really need to thank Saki later...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (After I do make the switch to go credit-based, we probably won't be able to do stuff like this as much...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(No, enough about that.
That's exactly why I should make the most of this time!)

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We did so much just now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did.
We crammed so much into a short amount of time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It feels like I just spent a three-day weekend hanging out with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It does... I haven't had many chances to hang out like this lately, so it felt like a nice escape from things.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree...
Our solo show kept us busy for a while too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it did!
I'm glad we got to take a break and just have fun for a change♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What do you think, Minori, Haruka?
Did you both have fun today...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Of course, we'll always remember today.
Right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really, really appreciate you all gathering like this, and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm truly grateful to have friends like you who give us so much support...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, for me...
Just having met you all is the greatest of memories...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I couldn't have asked for better friends.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
We did it, Ichi, Shiho, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess it was worth doing this today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much for putting this party together in such a hurry! It was really, reeaally fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is also why...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Having to say goodbye for today is a little tough...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, no...
It's not over yet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We still have another surprise for you both!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Another surprise?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We went and got you presents before my shift!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Here, it's these.
Matching ballpoint pens for the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
They're nice ones from a nice brand!
And they feel really nice to write with!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You could be a little more descriptive, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We weren't sure what to get you two at first, but we thought something practical that you can use while you work would be best...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So...
You're always writing up stream proposals and scripts, right? We thought you could use these to make your edits.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku even told me one time how it's always nice to have a multicolor pen on hand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You all put that much thought into these...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I know this might make it feel like a chapter of your life is coming to a close... But again, this isn't goodbye.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What she said! We all wanna be friends forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Getting your homework done and stuff's gonna be pretty hard, so don't be afraid to ask for help if you think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If we're going to be ready to help them whenever, we'll need to take really good notes during class.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?! Minori...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you sooo much! You're all the best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't think... I'll ever, ever forget this day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna treasure the time we spent together today! Forever!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, settle down...
